payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether, during Federal FY2025, Section B(1)(a) quarterly progress reporting on cyanide compliance activities remained applicable or had terminated because cyanide effluent limitations were already achieved. The packet grounds the conditional reporting language and the 12-month post-effective-date compliance schedule, but it does not include the permit effective date (needed to compute the compliance deadline) or any evidence bearing on whether or when cyanide effluent limitation compliance was achieved. Without those facts, neither the affirmative (reporting still required during FY2025) nor the negative (obligation terminated upon achievement) can be established. Per P5 protocol, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
